changes.before: BragBook centers on the brag document itself — assembling your accomplishments into a polished document you maintain and share. Prodlog centers on the capture habit: a running log of quick, structured entries that the document, the review summary, and the portfolio are generated *from*. One starts with the artifact; the other starts with the workflow that feeds it.
changes.after: BragBook centers on the brag document itself: your accomplishments in one document you maintain, with export and a public profile when you want to share it. Prodlog centers on the log and what it gives back every week: prep before each 1:1, drafts at review time, and a portfolio when you move. Both let you share your work; the difference is that Prodlog is built for PM work and pays back on the 1:1 cadence, not only at review time.
